messages:
anita (DevEx): FYI found a weird flakiness in the sample-app streaming demo when users hit token refresh mid-stream. UI sometimes shows interleaved partials (aaa|bbb). Repro steps + logs below.

anita (DevEx): repro: start generation -> force auth refresh -> reconnect using Last-Event-ID header -> client gets fragments: 10,11 then 9 then 12. Render becomes 10,11,9,12.

carmen (sdk): Do we have a resume token in the payload or only rely on Last-Event-ID? JS SDK currently tries to dedupe by `event.id` but treats id as opaque; python SDK greedily appends in arrival order.

reza (eng-runtime): On hosted fallback path we only support Last-Event-ID. Dedicated uses X-Resume-Token. We didn't guarantee monotonicity of event.id across replays in fallback. That's a gap.

yuki (qa): I ran the flaky CI job with simulated reconnects. Observed that server sometimes replays cached frames from older pool with older ids. That explains the 9 after 11 case.

anita (DevEx): Attached client-side snippet showing parse behavior:
```js
// pseudo parse loop
for (const ev of sseStream) {
  // js-sdk: if seenIds.has(ev.id) continue
  // python-parser: push to queue in order of arrival
  applyChunk(ev.data)
}
```

carmen (sdk): Suggestion: SDKs should prefer explicit numeric chunk_index when present. If chunk_index exists, apply chunks by chunk_index and buffer short gaps (e.g., 100ms) before giving up. Also expose a `reorder_policy` opt in both clients.

reza (eng-runtime): Short term we can enforce stronger resume behavior for hosted fallback: attach X-Resume-Seed and never replay fragments unless resume seed matches. Longer term, unify resume semantics across hosted/dedicated.

yuki (qa): I'll add an integration test case that simulates: partial send -> drop -> reconnect -> server replay older fragments. Will assert client either reorders by chunk_index or drops older chunks.

carmen (sdk): I'll add python param `reorder_policy = "drop_older"` default. Also add `on_reorder` callback in python to match JS hook. Unit tests incoming.

anita (DevEx): Can someone estimate runtime patch ETA? We should also update the onboarding doc to call out resume differences and recommended client settings.

reza (eng-runtime): I can push a small guard by EOD: add X-Resume-Seed check + suppress stale replays. PR will reference perf microbench and include tests.

build-bot: CI: sample-apps/stream-resume-test queued (replay-inject=true).

ops-vela: noted. Linking infra ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/RESUME-401 (for longer-term unification).

anita (DevEx): Action list: reza -> runtime guard; yuki -> integration tests; carmen -> python reorder_policy + tests; anita -> sample-app PR + docs update. Will follow up with PR links. Thanks! :rocket:
